rule.summary: Select a common long double, double, or float type before the integer-only branch that applies integer promotions.

compiler_tree_observation: GCC13 omitted the intermediate int cast for short+float but kept one for unsigned-char ?: double; Clang18 included an intermediate int cast for both. Compiler trees insert or remove equivalent casts, so step order is checked against the C rule; compiler oracles validate resulting types and values.
